verdict.rationale: Data portability is a fair question for a cloud-hosted agent service, so the axis applies. The pack documents no user data export or account-exit capability. The Analytics API returns org usage time series for BI tools, and the document-creation and file-processing features are task outputs; neither is a bulk export of the user's data in open formats.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
